Subject: Intro + scheduling: Redwood demo for HarborTech (self-serve lead)

Hi Jason,

Thanks for signing up and for the quick trial activity — I’m Grace on the SDR team at Redwood. Naomi (AE) and Hiro (SE) are cc'd; we'd love to set a brief intro + tech walkthrough to show how Redwood can reduce inference latency for your models while keeping data isolation controls in place.

We know many HarborTech teams require IT/security to be present — please let us know if your security lead should join. To keep this tight, we typically do a 30–45 minute session: 20 minutes demo + 10–20 minutes Q&A.

Proposed slots in BST (you mentioned UK in the signup):
- Thu Mar 3 — 14:00–14:45 BST
- Thu Mar 3 — 15:00–15:45 BST
- Fri Mar 4 — 11:00–11:45 BST

If those don’t work, share a preferred window and we’ll try to accommodate. Quick Calendly link if helpful: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-demo?event=HT-2028-031

I’m attaching a short pre-demo checklist (what we ask IT to confirm ahead of time).

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
SDR | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (1 page)

Hi Grace — thanks for reaching out.

We absolutely want IT/security in the session. Our security team's availability is limited to the 13:00–15:00 BST window on weekdays because of on‑call rotations. Can you confirm someone from Redwood can make that slot?

Also, before we commit: two quick asks from IT/security (cc'ing Priya from IT Security in my reply):
- Can you share your SOC 2 summary and a short note on key management (KMS/HSM)?
- We prefer sessions not to be recorded unless we explicitly agree. Is that OK?

If you can meet 14:00–14:45 BST on Thu Mar 3 and provide the security docs, we can lock that in.

Cheers,
Jason
Director of Platform Engineering, HarborTech
Jason Lee <jason.lee@harbortech.co.uk>

Hi Jason / Priya — Naomi here (AE). Thanks for the heads up on the on‑call window and the security questions — both are reasonable.

14:00–14:45 BST on Thu Mar 3 works for our team. Hiro (cc'd, SE) will join remotely from Japan and Grace will run the intro. We’ll keep the session to 40 minutes to respect your team’s time: 20 min live demo (architecture + orchestration + cost controls), 15 min focused Q&A, 5 min next steps and mutual action plan.

On the security points:
- SOC 2 summary: shared link below (public summary + more details we can provide under NDA).
- KMS/HSM: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and offers integrations for HSM-backed keys in our Private deployments; I’ll include a short note below.
- Recording: understood — we won’t record the meeting unless you confirm.

Short KMS note (preview):
- Hosted API: redwood-managed encryption at rest; we offer bring-your-own-KMS for Dedicated/Private; key rotation and access logs are available via our audit pipeline.
- Private/VPC: option to deploy with customer KMS/HSM and restrict key access to their tenant.

Links:
- SOC2 summary: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/security/SOC2-summary.pdf
- Calendly (finalize): https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-demo?event=HT-2028-031

Would you like us to share a brief run‑of‑show and a one‑page tech checklist for your IT team ahead of time? We can send that in a separate email (attached).

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai

Hi Naomi / team — Priya from HarborTech IT Security. Thanks for proposing 14:00 BST. A few quick items we’d like to see before the session so we can prioritize internal attendance:  

1) One‑page network checklist (inbound IPs, ports, meeting link expectations).  
2) Clarify where logs and audit trails live and retention defaults.  
3) Confirmation that no recording will be kept by Redwood unless we explicitly agree.  
4) For Hosted API: detail on how customer data (payloads) are stored and whether any PII (if submitted) is used for model tuning.  

If you can send brief answers / one‑pagers on the above today we’ll confirm attendance for 14:00–14:45 BST.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
IT Security Lead | HarborTech
priya.singh@harbortech.co.uk
